    AI Overview
    For the 2026 Valspar Championship at Innisbrook’s Copperhead Course, top picks include betting favorites Xander Schauffele (+1000) and defending champion Viktor Hovland (+1600), alongside in-form players like Ryo Hisatsune (+3900) and Jacob Bridgeman (+2000), who finished 3rd here last year. The course favors accurate iron play and strong scrambling to navigate the "Snake Pit". 
    Top Favorites and Expert Picks 
    Xander Schauffele (+1000): The top-ranked player in the field and tournament favorite, according to Golfweek and Yahoo Sports. 
    Viktor Hovland (+1600): Defending champion coming in with strong form (four top-15s in six starts) and consistent putting, says CBS Sports. 
    Matt Fitzpatrick (+1400): A strong contender following a high finish at TPC Sawgrass, notes Golfweek. 
    Top Value and Sleepers 
    • Ryo Hisatsune (+3900): Recommended by Pro Golf Now for his impressive T4 finish last year and strong tee-to-green performance, says Pro Golf Now.
    • Jacob Bridgeman (+2000): Highlighted by DraftKings Network for his excellent form, including top-20s in all seven of his events this season, says DraftKings Network.
    • Jordan Spieth (+4000): A past winner and popular pick at longer odds, according to Mayo Media Newsletter.
    • Austin Smotherman (+5500): Ranked #1 in Strokes Gained: Approach on Tour, noted by VSiN. 
    Course Factors
    The Copperhead Course is a 7,352-yard, par-71 layout requiring precision over distance, often rewarding accurate iron play to avoid trouble, says Golfweek https://golfweek.usatoday.com/story/sports/golf/pga/2026/03/18/valspar-championship-odds-picks-and-pga-tour-
